Select molecules associated with the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then join docs on doc_id and filter by doc_chembl_id CHEMBL5360622. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
